总是.pinyin: tā zǒng shì àn shí lái dào gōng sī.
总是.en: He always comes to the company on time.

最近.pinyin: wǒ zuì jìn gōng zuò bǐ jiào máng.
最近.en: My work has been relatively busy recently.

作业.pinyin: qǐng dà jiā àn shí jiāo zuò yè.
作业.en: Please hand in homework on time, everyone.

作用.zh: 这种药对感冒很有效作用。
作用.pinyin: zhè zhǒng yào duì gǎn mào hěn yǒu xiào zuò yòng.
作用.en: This medicine has a great effect on colds.
